row.title: GATE-SETTLE-2: owner gates settle on live evidence; the owner page filters closed gates
row.body: The /owner page asked the owner to connect GitHub and allow repository settings after both were done. Causes: needsyou --settle only knew env: secrets in Actions, which cannot see credentials the Worker seals itself; the dashboard read needs-you.json raw instead of the unattended.json closed-dependency rule; the OWNER-LINKS-1 probe called NEEDS.map on an object and threw. Fix: resolved_when accepts a list and http:URL ~ TEXT live evidence; dashboard openNeeds() applies the unattended rule.
